title: PAKDD 2027
institution: PAKDD 2027 (31st Pacific-Asia Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining)
field: Data mining, knowledge discovery, machine learning
about: Call for papers for PAKDD 2027, the 31st Pacific-Asia Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, in Wellington, New Zealand, 29 June-2 July 2027. Research, applied data science, survey and LLM/agentic AI track papers are due 20 November 2026 (AoE).
requirements: Research, Applied Data Science, Survey and Large Language Models & Agentic AI tracks share the main deadline
Springer LNCS template; double-blind review; submission via CMT

upskill.name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modelling I
why: "Data mining, knowledge discovery, machine learning" (record.field) -> "Apply unsupervised learning techniques, including clustering and dimensionality reduction, to discover structure in data without predefined labels."
"Machine learning" (record.skills) -> "Build supervised learning models for regression and classification using methods such as support vector machines, random forests, and gradient boosting."

"Applied Data Science ... track" (record.qualifications) -> "Compare predictive approaches according to the structure of the data, the analytical objective, and the assumptions of the modelling method."
